sets.relationshipLabel: a broad category and one specific named example of it
sets.explanation: Joker is a specific villain and the Batmobile is a specific vehicle—each pair links a general category to its famous instance.

sets.relationshipLabel: the hero/villain and the signature tool of their trade
sets.explanation: Batman is never without his Batarang, and Catwoman is defined by her whip—each hero or villain paired with the tool that marks them.

sets.relationshipLabel: a substance and the effect it necessarily produces
sets.explanation: Bane's Venom always grants superhuman strength and Scarecrow's toxin always induces fear hallucinations—each substance guarantees its effect.

sets.relationshipLabel: the time of day and the activity that belongs to it
sets.explanation: Night is when patrol happens and dusk is when a stakeout begins—each time of day paired with the activity it typically brings, not one it must.

glossary.definition: A fictional chemical compound from comic lore, sprayed or released to affect a person's mind.

definitions.definition: Someone who causes trouble on purpose and usually gets in the hero's way.
A grinning chaos-lover who loves a twisted prank more than any actual goal.
Anything built to carry you from one place to another.
A sleek, armored car built for speeding through the city at night.
A caped crusader who fights crime from the shadows using brains and gadgets.
A boomerang-shaped throwing weapon used to disarm or trip up enemies.
A cunning cat-burglar who moves silently and always lands on her feet.
A long flexible weapon that can lash, snag, or disarm from a distance.
A dangerous drug that pumps the user full of raw physical power.
Power far beyond what a normal body could ever produce.
A fictional chemical compound from comic lore, sprayed or released to affect a person's mind.
Terrifying visions that make someone see nightmares that aren't really there.
The dark hours after sunset when the world quiets down.
Walking or driving a route repeatedly to keep watch over an area.
The dim in-between time just as the sun disappears.
Quietly watching a place for a long stretch, waiting for something to happen.
